decisions.minimumMissingWitness: Bind one exact authorized continuing permanent item enhancement or innate magical manifestation, distinguish the ongoing expression from intrinsic item/creature/class entitlement, identify the legal actor/acquisition/owner/custodian and operative state, and supply any explicit protection and source-owned ending/remainder/recreation contract. Then demonstrate a paid 26-RP Wave (actual final price/cadence), immutable geometry/capture, no-save component ending, remaining mundane body/contents/custody and attempted subsequent use with no invented repair, refund or identity deletion. Missing campaign possession alone remains conditional; the continuing-property classification and required positive terminal history are the whole-identity gate.
decisions.reassessment: The 91 refreshed source bindings were compared with Return237: 90 are byte-identical; only authored_review_index.json changed. Current Glove of Null Ink CH03 acquisition, physical glove, Action/10-foot Air Writing, one inscription and 600-second deadline are present. They do not establish that the underlying continuing writing entitlement is an independently terminable enchantment or give its source-owned permanent-removal/remainder contract. Ending its finite inscription is not that witness. Recorded newer acceptances in the index are preserved, but an index pointer alone is not a supplied concrete item/property history. The exact prior no-save spell/form/summon/permanent-ward/protected-book traces were freshly replayed; none silently substitutes for this branch.

decisions.minimumMissingWitness: Bind an actual continuing unique/item/innate magical component and its applicable suppression/lifecycle contract, legal access/acquisition/owner/custody and operative-use history. Demonstrate actual Permission-mode deny/allow with a known source handle, retained spent uses/contents and absolute clock, source expiry/ending while denied, and only still-live expression resuming without refill or recreation. If asserting Transmutation-mode treatment of that component, additionally bind its actual generating Transmutation classification; do not infer it from appearance. A finite inscription alone must not be presented as proof of the unsourced permanent entitlement contract.
decisions.reassessment: The same current Glove source and relevant integration/class files are byte-identical to Return237. Glove acquisition and finite writing facts are present, not absent. No new complete operative unique/item/innate component and active-use history was supplied. Permission mode may identify a known actual source without inventing its school; lack of a school label alone is not a Permission-mode blocker. Transmutation mode needs actual generating-school evidence only when that specific mode is being claimed. Prior deny/allow, two-mode, overlap, source-ending, owner-death and antimagic component traces freshly replay; the unique-property records remain unresolved.
